app.title: Spreadsheet Inspector
app.subtitle: Private spreadsheet viewer and inspector for your browser

home.dropzonePrompt: Drop a spreadsheet anywhere in this area
home.supportedFormats: XLSX · XLS · XLSM · XLSB · CSV · TSV · ODS
home.privacyNotice: Processed on this device. Nothing is uploaded.
home.recentNotice: Recent items store metadata only. Original files remain on your device.
home.reopenPrompt: Please select the original file from your device to reopen.

warnings.title: Workbook warnings
warnings.macroDesc: This workbook contains macros. Macros are never executed by this viewer.
warnings.externalLinksDesc: External hyperlinks require explicit confirmation before opening.

security.externalLinkWarning: You are about to navigate to an external website:
security.blockedLinkDesc: This link uses an unsupported or potentially hazardous protocol ({protocol}) and was blocked for your security.

general.title: General
general.recentFilesDesc: Keep non-sensitive list of opened files (name, size, date) on this device.
general.linkConfirmationDesc: Always show confirmation dialog before opening external websites.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.themeDesc: System matches your operating system preference.

language.title: Language
language.desc: Spreadsheet cell values and formula names are never translated.

privacy.title: Privacy & Storage
privacy.statement: Private by design. Your files are processed entirely in your browser using local Web Workers. No spreadsheet content is uploaded to any server.
privacy.clearDataDesc: Removes saved preferences and recent file metadata from this browser.
privacy.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all stored settings and metadata?

about.title: About
about.description: Spreadsheet Inspector is a browser-first, privacy-focused tool for viewing and inspecting spreadsheets offline.

errors.unsupportedFile: Unsupported file format. Please open an XLSX, XLS, XLSM, XLSB, CSV, TSV, or ODS file.
errors.corruptFile: Unable to read spreadsheet. The file may be corrupt or encrypted.
errors.memoryError: The file is too large to parse with available browser memory.
errors.readError: Failed to read file from disk.

pwa.updateAvailableDesc: A new version of Spreadsheet Inspector is ready. Updating will refresh the application.
pwa.offlineReady: Application is ready to work offline.
